name: Commander
summary: ASX-listed telco/IT services group (Commander Communications Ltd), grew from the Commander business-phone-systems brand; parent of PBBA (iBurst wireless); entered administration 2008, SME/telco business acquired by M2 Telecommunications 2009 (brand continues as a Vocus brand).

events.details: Commander Communications Ltd entered voluntary administration in 2008; SME/telco business acquired by M2 Telecommunications in 2009. Homepage live (HTTP 200) through 2009 in Wayback, then redirects.

M2 COMMANDER PTY LTD (ACN 136 950 082) is the M2 acquisition vehicle, registered 15 Jun 2009 — after Commander Communications collapsed — not the original ASX-listed entity; business name COMMANDER only assigned to it from 17 Jun 2014. Cited here as the successor brand holder, not the historical ISP.
